mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET status=#{targetStatus} WHERE id=#{orderId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND status=#{expectedStatus}
UPDATE orders SET status=#{targetStatus} WHERE id=#{orderId} AND status=#{expectedStatus}
UPDATE orders SET status=1,pay_time=NOW(),pay_amount=#{amount},actual_amount=#{amount} WHERE id=#{orderId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND status=0
mapper.select: SELECT DATE(create_time) day,COUNT(*) orderCount,COALESCE(SUM(pay_amount),0) amount FROM orders WHERE status=4 AND create_time >=#{start} AND deleted=0 GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ORDER BY day

SELECT oi.product_id productId,MAX(oi.product_name) productName,SUM(oi.quantity) quantity,COALESCE(SUM(oi.price*oi.quantity),0) revenue FROM order_item oi JOIN orders o ON o.id=oi.order_id WHERE o.status=4 AND o.deleted=0 GROUP BY oi.product_id ORDER BY quantity DESC LIMIT #{limit}
